info.name: Quidax Payments API
info.description:
Accept crypto payments, pay out, and settle in the currency you choose.

Set `secretKey` (sec_...) in collection variables. Initialize Transaction needs the PUBLIC key instead. Docs: https://docs.quidax.com/payments

request.description: Creates the record of what the customer owes. Returns a reference with status `INITIATED` — no address exists and no rate is locked yet. Takes your **public** key.
Assigns a payment currency, locks the rate, and returns the wallet address, exact crypto amount and a QR code. Moves the transaction to `PENDING`, which starts the 60-minute expiry window.
Returns the current status of a transaction. Use it when a webhook is delayed or to reconcile — it supplements webhooks rather than replacing them.
Creates a hosted checkout link. Static links carry a fixed amount, dynamic links let the customer enter one. Links are reusable and each use creates a new transaction.

query.description: Filter links created on or after this date.
Filter links created on or before this date.
Search links by title or currency code.
Filter by link status. `archived` returns deleted links.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of payment links for your merchant account. By default, only active (non-deleted) links are returned. Use the `status` parameter to retrieve archived links.

variable.description: The unique ID of the payment link (bq_pl_…).

request.description: Retrieve the details of a single payment link by its ID.

variable.description: The unique ID of the payment link to update

request.description: Updates one or more fields on an existing payment link. At least one field must be provided.

variable.description: The unique ID of the payment link to delete.

request.description: Soft-deletes a payment link. Deleted links are no longer accessible to customers and are excluded from your default list view. This action cannot be undone via the API.

header.description: Optional. Reusing the same key within the quote window replays the same response for your account and environment.

request.description: Quotes a wallet-to-wallet conversion. Quotes last roughly 10 seconds and can only be used once.

header.description: Optional. Reusing the same key within the quote window replays the same response for your account and environment.
Optional. Reusing the same key within the quote window replays the same response for your account and environment.

request.description: Returns a live rate and equivalent amount for a currency pair. A preview only — it does not move funds.

header.description: Recommended. Reusing a key returns the cached result for your account and environment.

request.description: Executes a conversion using a quote from Create Quote. Quotes expire in roughly 10 seconds and can only be used once. Send an Idempotency-Key so a timed-out request is safe to retry.

query.description: Filter conversions by your own reference.

request.description: Returns your conversion history for reconciliation.

Test mode only. Moves a transaction to `successful`, `overpaid`, `underpaid` or `abandoned` and fires the matching webhook. The exact shape of this endpoint is being confirmed — see the Testing guide.
Replays the webhook for a transaction. Useful when your endpoint was down.
Returns every supported currency grouped as `FIAT` or `CRYPTO`, with the networks each crypto is available on. Fetch this rather than hard-coding currency IDs.
